name: Grilled Pork Chop & Honeyed Zucchini with Snap Pea-Radish Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 medium zucchini squash
3 (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas
1 ½ bunches radish

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a small bowl (set lemons aside for later). Add oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the lemon oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice zucchini lengthwise into ¼-inch thick planks; transfer to a large plate and drizzle both sides with the lemon oil.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add zucchini planks and grill, flipping once, until charred and fork-tender, about 3 minutes per side; return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on another large plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, bone-in
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp sage, dried

instructions.primary_message: Once the zucchini is done, coat the pan with oil; working in batches if necessary, add pork chops and grill until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Add to the plate with the zucchini.
While the chops are cooking, juice reserved lemons into a medium bowl; add mayo and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp dill, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut snap peas crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork chops, zucchini, and salad between plates. Drizzle honey over the zucchini and enjoy!
